tenures.bio:
Wrestlers Appearance

Head Shot

Lance has brown with blond highlighted short spiky hair shaved on the sides And combed spiked but back a bit so it isnt straight up spiky hair but more back. He has a model look baby face, defined facial features. Glass baby blue eyes perfect nose perfect mouth strong high cheekbones perfect model like jaw structure.

Upper Body and Back

Lance has a well-built upper body with chiseled 8 pack abs, Has solid defined pecks obviously spends amounts of time in the gym. He is sculpted like a Greek statue with perfect muscle and almost no body fat. His arms arm bulging with biceps, a Dragon tattoo from the top of his left arm all the way down to the forearm. On the right arm is an Knife tattoo dripping with fresh blood Tattoo. On his sculpted back is the word Assassin  tattooed from shoulder to shoulder.

Lower Body

Lance wears Gold with Baby Blue Trim on the right leg on the pants it says Perfection down the side In Bold White with Baby Blue outlined lettering. His boots are Black martial arts knee high style (See Ken Shamrock Or Chris Jericho for boot style)

RING ENTRANCE

'Debonair' by Dope blasts over the PA. System. The lights are dimmed. Lance waits to hear the roars and cheers of the fans before stepping through the curtain. Lance stands at the top of the walkway looking to his right. And then back to his left, looking at the fans cheering for him. Lance then begins flexing and posing at the top of the walkway driving the fans wild as the spot light focuses on him in darkness. Pyro Cannons from both sides of the ring fires high into the air forming the word in pyro HIGHLIGHT. Lance then begins to make his walk down the isle. The lights still dimmed. The spotlight follows Lance until he arrives at the ring. The lights to the arena then turn back on. Lance then quickly jumps up on the second turnbuckle on one side of the ring, Lance reaches his hands out to his side as to say who's better then me? Lance will continue to do this on the other three corners as well. Lance will then make his way to the center of the ring. He will wait for the peek moment. l flex and pose in the center of the ring. Pyro explodes behind him from left to right, And then back again. Lances music then stops playing, and Lance is ready for action.

 MOVE LIST

HIGH RISK

#1 Spring Board Missile Drop Kick

Description: Lance spring boards him self off the top rope drop kicking his opponent

#2 Perfecter

Lance grabs a steel chair. Tosses it in his opponent's hands. Then drop kicks it in his or her face. NOTE: Only used during hardcore no rules matches. Or behind the refs back.

#3 Super Perfecter

Lance stands atop the top turnbuckle. When his opponent is facing him. Lance tosses a chair into his or her hands. Then missile dropkicks the chair into his or her face. NOTE: He only uses this during hardcore no rules or behind the refs back.

#4 Irish Whip Standing Hurracannrana

Lance sends his opponent into the ropes off an Irish whip. When his opponent bounces off the rope and comes back at Lance. Lance jumps up locks his legs around his opponent's head. Flipping his opponent headfirst onto the ring matt.

#5 5-Star Split Leg Moon Sault

Lance after having laid out at a 90-degree angle jumps up on the top turnbuckle. Lance then drops down with his legs out in splits like motion. Causing the force from the ropes to send Lance in a bullet like back flip onto his opponent.

#6 Spinning Leg Heel Kick

Lance either Irish whips or bounces off the ropes him self. But apron return jumps and through his legs in a spinning motion causing him to connect with his opponent in a double leg heel kick.

#7 Legacy Press

Lance jumps on top of the turnbuckle. His opponent on his feet. Lance jumps from the turnbuckle nailing a shooting star press on a standing opponent. NOTE: Can also be done to a man out or inside the ring from the top turnbuckle. Or can be done as a springboard once again in or outside the ring.

#8 Super Hurracannrana Pin

Lance sits his opponent up on top of the turnbuckle pad. Lance up to the very top turnbuckle as well facing his opponent. Lance then jumps and locks his opponent's head with his legs. Flipping his opponent head first into the matt where Lance hangs on and lays on top of his opponent for a pin

#9 5-Star Moon Sault

The opponent will be lying at a 90-degree angle. But the opponent can also be standing. Lance jumps up onto the top turnbuckle. Facing the crowed. Then back flips on to his opponent

#10 Over the Top Rope Cannonball Dive

Lances opponent will be standing outside the ring Lance can either bounce off the ropes or just do a full out sprint. Lance then in a cannonball form FRONT FLIP Dives over the top rope onto his opponent.

#11 Over the Top Rope Cork Screw Dive

Just Like the cannonball dive, Lance can either bounce off the opposite ropes or do a full sprint. Either way, But this time instead of a front flip over the top rope onto a standing opponent. He flies over the top rope in a CORKSCREW DIVE

#12 Diamond Dust

Lance standing on the second turnbuckle locks his opponent in a Dragon Sleeper like hold. Lance then flips forward and brings his opponent down into a STUNNER

#13 Twisting 5-Star Senton Splash

Lance jumps up on top of the turnbuckle facing the crowed. Lance then jumps backwards in a cork screw spin then flips forward into a SENTONBOMB NOTE: Can be used on a standing opponent.

#14 Shooting 5-Star Press

Lance jumps up upon the top turnbuckle. His opponent lays down on tat a 90 degree angle. Lance then jumps and does a forward back flip onto his opponent. A SHOOTING STAR PRESS

#15 450 Splash

Lance with his opponent laying on the matt in a 90-degree angle. From the turnbuckle Lance does a flip and a half landing in a splash onto his opponent.

#16 Legacy Rana

With Lances o standing. Lance from the top turnbuckle. Does a front flip onto his opponent only to lock his opponent's head between his legs? Lance then does a snap Hurracanranna Flipping his opponent over fast and hard headfirst into the matt Lance hangs on and locks both of his opponent's legs for the pin. Move also known as DRAGONRANA

#17 Spinning Heel Kick from the Top Rope

With a standing Opponent. Lance from the top turnbuckle jumps with a spinning heel kick connecting with his opponent's head or face. NOTE: This move can be done in and out of the ring. And can also be done as a springboard. In and out of the ring.

#18 5-Star Frog Splash

With his opponent laying at a 90 Degree angle. Lance from the top turnbuckle gets as much leap under him as he can. Flying as high s he can. Then executing a FROG Splash.

#19 5-Star Face Buster

With his opponent lying at a 90 degree angle face up. Lance climbs to the top turnbuckle chair in hand. Lance then jumps doing a summersault leg drop then placing the chair under his 

Legs as he crushes his opponent's face with the chair. NOTE: Lance only does this move in no rules matches will do the move with out the chair and just connect with a front summersault leg drop.

#20 Spearing Drop Kick

Lance Irish Whips His Opponent Into The Ropes, He then Grabs some momentom by hitting the opposite ropes, With returning momentum Lance jumps in the air in a drop kick like catching his returning opponent with a spear like drop kick in the face almost taking the opponents head clean off

SUBMISSION HOLDS

#1 Sharpshooter

Lance's opponent on the matt. Hooks the mans legs. He then steps through with on leg. Lance then crosses the mans legs and turns the man over causing pressure on the mans legs and back.

#2 Figure four Leg Lock

The opponent on the ground. Lance grabs one of the mans legs and spin He then grabs the other leg and crosses the mans one leg over the other leg. Lance then falls To his back laying his one free leg across the mans crossed leg. Causing extreme pain to the mans leg.

#3 Goku-Raku Stretch

With his opponent sitting up. Lance hooks his opponent in a full nelson. Lance then steps over and put his opponent in a full nelson camel clutch like hold wrenching back causing his opponent extreme pain.

#4 Ne-Han

This hold is like the Goku except. Lances opponent is sitting up, But this time Lance takes his opponents arms and pulls tin the opposite direction choking his opponent. Then Lance once again steps over in a camel clutch like hold choking out his opponent with his own arms.

#5 Triangle Submission

His opponent lying on his back. Lance grabs one of his opponent's arms. Lance then hooks almost what looks like a figure four around the mans Arms and neck. Then squeezes his legs together causing the man to fall asleep or pass out.

#6 Rolling Leg Lock

This is done from a standing position. Lance locks up with his opponent. He then rolls his opponent while rolling him self at the same time. His opponent ends up on his back. And Lance is on his back with his opponent's leg in a knee bar causing much pain to the opponent.

#7 Butterfly Lock

Lance hooks a double under hook on his opponent's arms. He then rolls his opponent over to the left. Still holding onto the under hook, He hooks his opponents head under his arm. Locking his opponent's head in a forward position. While pulling on his opponents left arm stretching out his opponents shoulder causing extreme pain to his opponent.

#8 Legacy Sleeper

With the opponent on the matt sitting up. Lance hooks his arm down and around the mans neck and then wrenches back causing the man pain and sometimes to go to sleep. ALSO KNOWN AS THE DRAGON SLEEPER.

#9 Legacy Stretch

Lance steps over the mans left leg wit his own left leg. Lance then hooks the mans head with his left arm Pulling back. Lance then pulls back on the mans right arm causing his opponents shoulder to separate.

#10 Ankle Lock

Lance with his opponent face down on the matt. Grabs one of his opponent's feet. He then twists the ankle in causing extreme pain. And possibly quick tap out. Some times used as a finisher.

#11 Cocky Pin

With his opponent on his back. Lance puts one foot on the man for a pin while posing. NOTE: This never gets the win. But draws a lot of heat from the crowed.

TECH/SUPLEXES

#1 Full Neilson Perfect Plex Pin

Lance locks his opponent in a fullnelson. He then Suplexes the man back over his head and bridges him self-up. For the pin. This is also known as the DRAGON SUPLEX

#2 Belly to Belly Perfect Plex

Lance locks his arms around the mans back bringing him belly to belly with Lance. Lance then launches the man over his head and onto his back releasing him.

#3 German Release Perfect Plex

Lance with the mans back to him raps the man around his waist. He then lifts the man over his releasing the man so that he is fold on his head and back of his neck.

#4 Northern Lights Perfect Plex Pin

Lance locks the man around his back. Then Lance puts his head under the arm of his opponent Lance then lifts the man over his head onto his back. Lance bridges and holds the man there for the pin.

#5 Belly To Back Perfect Plex

Lance like the belly to belly suplex grabs the man around his back. But this time Lance lifts the man to the side driving the mans back into the matt hard.

#6 Capture Perfect plex

Usually used as a counter move. Lance hooks the mans head and one of his legs. Lance then launch the man over his head and onto his back.

#7 Head And Arm Perfect Plex

Lance locks the head and arm of his opponent. Lifts his opponent of his feet tossing him with force over his head with the man landing on his head or neck.

HIGH IMPACT

 

  

#1 5-Star Kick

With standing opponent. Lance attacks to the face or head with a standing side martial arts kick.

#2 sit Down Legacy Bomb from the Top Rope

Lance from the top turnbuckle hooks his opponent in a power bomb like lock. Lance then jumps from the top turnbuckle with opponent still locked. Then lands with a sit down power bomb usually causing the opponent extreme pain.

#3 5-Star Thunder Driver

Lance lifts his opponent in like a body slam form. Then does a sit down pile driver.

#4 Brain Buster

Lance lifts his opponent in a normal suplex like hold. But then drops his opponent headfirst into the matt.

#5 Irish Whip Tornado Back Breaker

Lance Irish whips his opponent the ropes. Upon return Lance lifts his opponent up onto his shoulders. Lance then spins around twice and then drops the man onto his knee back first.

#6 Running Sit Down Legacy Bomb Pin

Lance lifts his opponent in a power bomb style lock. Upon doing so. Lance runs across the ring. During this Lance will drop his opponent into a sit down power bomb and holds on for the pin.

#7 Super Back Buster

Lance from the top turnbuckle. Lifts his opponent onto his shoulders in a torture rack like hold. Lance then jumps from the turnbuckle. While lifts his opponent over his head and busting his opponents back onto his knee? The reverse of a SUPER GUT BUSTER THUS IT BEING A SUPER BACK BUSTER

#8 Fisherman DDT Pin

Lance hooks his opponent's head under his arm. And then hooks his opponents leg as if he were to do a fisherman suplex. But then Lance drives his opponent's head into the matt with a snap ddt move. Still holding onto the fisherman hold for the pin.

#9 Irish Whip Gut Buster

Lance Irish whips his opponent into the ropes. Upon his opponents return. Lance lifts his opponent high in the air. As his opponent comes down. Lance drives his knee into the gut of his opponent

COMBO'S

#1 Lance puts his opponent up apon his shOlder. Lance then charges diagonal across the ring driving his opponent's back into the turnbuckle. Lance then ties the man to the tree of whoa. Lance then goes back across the ring once again. And this time charges his opponent nailing him in the mid section with a running drop kick. Lance then lifts the mans head from the ground. He then hooks it on his shoulder. And runs forward pulling the man off the top turnbuckle and nailing him with a running neck breaker

#2 Lance has his opponent in the corner. Lance picks the man up if to power bomb him. Lance then power bombs the mans head into the top turnbuckle pad. As the man sit up being held up by the turnbuckle pads. Lance delivers a roundhouse kick with so much power behind it spins Lance then does the roundhouse kick one more time but immediately after drop front kicks the man in his head. And face.

#3 Lance grabs his opponent by his left arm and stretches it out leaving his body open for attack. Lance then uses his left leg to deliver a series of kicks too first to the mans stomach. Then to his chest. And then one to his head. And as the man is about to fall in pain. Lance front round house jump kicks the man in the back of the head.

#4 This is an extreme series of kicking to a mans body. Lance starts out by kicking the man with his right leg to the mans ribs. Followed by a left kick to the mans ribs And then once again another left kick to the mans ribs. Then a right head. Causing the opponent to drop to his knees. Lance then continues kicking him. Lance then delivers a left kick to the mans head while on his knees. Follows by a right knee to the mans face. Then a shin kick to the mans head causing him to fall face first onto the matt from his knees. Lance then finishes the flurry wit back of the mans head with his right foot.

BIOGRAPHY

It all started January 15th 1983. A baby was born to Steven and Terri Heinrichsen, they named this baby boy Lance, Lance Heinrichsen. Lance also had an older brother by the name of Shawn. During Lance's birth his mother Terri Heinrichsen died just as he was placed into her warm loving arms. This day may have been the finish to this once loving family.

The three men grew up in an old servant's house built in the late 1800's in front of a rich plantation owner's home. Fields where they used to grow crops and trees spread on for miles and miles as far as the eye could see. By this time Lance Heinrichsen was 5 where as his brother Shawn was 10. They mainly hung out together while their dad Steven Heinrichsen worked in a car repair shop. The family was dealt hardships but they pushed on as well as they could with out the loving mother and beautiful wife.

Now the town they lived in wasn't very big. It was just outside of the regions between Arizona and California. Most people here were up to date on all the current business whether it had any thing to do with them or not. The word is that Steven Heinrichsen went mad over time. People began to disappear in this town of probably 800 people. Soon after Steven Heinrichsen too had disappeared leaving his two sons behind. When local officials asked the children of there fathers where a bouts the two children suspiciously clamed up not speaking a word of their father from that day forward. It wasn't to long before they placed to two young boys in an orphanage, Shawn was quickly adopted soon after arriving but Lance, Lance spent 5 years in that home till he was 10 years old with out his brother. But one day a rich family adopted Lance Heinrichsen taking them into their home. There the young boy grew up privileged with every thing a young man could want. He was extremely attractive and a ladies man, drove an incredible car and excelled in all sports his put his mind too.

One day at 16 years of age, Lance Heinrichsen left school early during gym class. It was if something was calling him, summoning his soul in a direction that his body couldn't control. That day he found his brother back in his old hometown. This was around the time of the GOD'S HAND MURDERS! A week later after Lance Heinrichsens disappearance, Shawn Heinrichsen turned up missing. Lance too turned up missing neither to be heard from again. Like a family of ghosts vanishing into thin air. Weeks later the GODS HAND MURDERS Stopped and the investigating officer disappeared as well.

About two years later, a young man resembling Lance Heinrichsen was seen wrestling on the Indy circuit cleaning up becoming one of the most decorated wrestlers to have ever lives. This young 18 year old mans name was Lance Perfection. When asked about his past Lance was more then happy to share his rich kid up bringing, and his wrestling stints in Japan and his short time in Mexico learning all the different styles to become successful. He spoke of the time he spent in the Dojo in Japan and in the Hart Dungeon in Calgary Alberta Canada, as well as his in the USA learning the style and what it takes to make the super big time. But strangely enough, when asked about family or and parents, the young super star seemed to clam up and dodge the question. As well as when asked his real name he would stop to think for a second and then answer. 'My name is Lance Perfection and that is all you will ever need to know.'

We have watched this young 18 year old then now 19 year old pay his dues and win every thing he has ever deserved. People dieing to know the past of this kid dug through his files at one point a few months after he had signed with his first big name federation NTICW. But they found nothing more then incomplete material. The rest had been burned in an electrical fire at the hall of records. When they searched his name, they found he had legally changed it to Lance Perfection and that there had been a smudge but UN legible note of his former name, which no matter what they tried, could not even come close to making out to be read.

Lance Perfection just recently signed with RUSH where he has been seen to have a successful future and maybe even found a home. He has made the big time and he knows it and will fight and do whatever he can to keep it. Whether Lance Perfection is Lance Heinrichsen or not will always is a mystery. But what the real mystery that people should be focusing on now is how much talent does this young 19 year really have and how much more will we see now in the big time then we have in his past accomplishments.

name: Phoenix

tenures.source: PCW's own database (lot 0159), bio 10733 (his own card) and the 2001 bookings of bio 708; PCW's own served cards
tenures.note: PCW's own cards bill him from Toronto, Ontario, Canada, entering to Linkin Park's "One Step Closer" (Friday Fusion 20, 2 February 2001, and on), finishing with Into the Ashes and setting it up with the Cry for Help. He wrestled for Asylum beside Miyagawa through February to April 2001 (Sabotage 1, 11 March 2001: "Miyagawa and Phoenix representing Asylum"), was "the former Asylum member" by Turmoil 31 (1 May 2001), fought for PCW2 at Gold and Glory (10 June 2001) and turned on Miyagawa at Back to Old School (16 September 2001). PCW's database books his appearances on bio 708, the card that carries Jay Phoenix's own fields; his own card, bio 10733 (a PCW2 card), books none. Turmoil 62 (26 December 2001) and Friday Fusion 67 (11 January 2002) are his by a presumed reading: Turmoil 62 names Miyagawa as "Phoenix's former mentor, and the man Phoenix tried to forcefully retire", and on Fusion 67 he sides with Clyde's crew against Asylum.

identity.note: Two PCW characters split by a presumed reading. PCW's database card 708, billed Phoenix, carries Jay Phoenix's own fields (Flagstaff, Arizona; "Phoenix Rising" by Annihilator; the Phoenix Rising finisher set up by Firestorm) but books this Phoenix's 2001 appearances; card 10733 holds this Phoenix's own fields (Toronto, Ontario, Canada; "One Step Closer" from Linkin Park; Into the Ashes set up by Cry for Help; Asylum) and books none. Every card field differs. PCW's own cards bill this Phoenix from Toronto to "One Step Closer" from February 2001, and introduce Jay Phoenix as a man who "represents...uh, himself" on Friday Fusion 60 (23 November 2001), billed from Flagstaff to "Phoenix Rising" (Sabotage 27, 2 December 2001). No document names one player behind both, and nothing in PCW's database ties the two cards to one player. REVISIT TRIGGER: a document naming one player behind both, or the player's own word.
A shared ring name only: the other federations' characters billed or also known as Phoenix are other characters; nothing held names any of them beside PCW's Toronto Phoenix of 2001.

caption: Billed from Toronto and entering to Linkin Park's "One Step Closer", the high-flier who came up as Miyagawa's protégé in Asylum in early 2001, broke from the stable that April and ambushed his old mentor at Back to Old School that September.

tenures.role: commentator
tenures.note: RUSH's colour commentator from its first show. The fed's own staff page (about August 2002) lists Kris Raves as "Colour Commentator" beside James Williams, "Play By Play Commentator", and Adrenaline 1 (2 May 2002) opens on "the two man announce team of James Williams and the sadistic Kris Raves". His speaker lines are on the 21 structured cards, Adrenaline 1 to 6, Ignition 2002, Adrenaline 8 to 20 and Crossroads 2002 (a third voice, Jessica, shares the table on Adrenaline 1 to 6 and Ignition 2002), and on the two scripts that are not yet structured: Rising From the Ashes (13 Oct 2002) and the six-month anniversary show (1 Nov 2002, its replays and awards). Adrenaline 7 (20 Jun 2002) has no page and Adrenaline 21 to 23 have no result on file, so the run is dated by the pages that carry him, not claimed beyond them. Each of the 21 cards carries a commentary appearance; the two scripts carry none because they hold no structured card.
